info.name: Palo Alto Networks Threat Vault API
info.description:
REST API for querying Palo Alto Networks threat intelligence including threat signature metadata, ATP (Advanced Threat Prevention) analysis reports, content release notes, and API usage statistics. The Threat Vault provides access to the full catalog of antivirus, anti-spyware, vulnerability protection, and DNS Security signatures used by PAN-OS firewalls. Enables security operations teams to look up specific threats by ID, CVE, SHA-256, or name and retrieve historical signature data for threat hunting and incident response. Authentication uses an API key passed in the X-API-KEY header.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
